title: Safe Notifications
tagline: Keep your web3 community up to date with on-chain and off-chain notifications delivered directly from your Safe multisig.
description:
You are a community manager in a DAO. How do you make sure that ALL your DAO members get notified about important issues? What if there is an event that requires urgent action, like voting on an expiring proposal?

Safe Notifications lets you instantly reach your community both on-chain with PUSH Protocol (interfaces: dapp, browser extension, mobile apps) and off-chain with IDriss (email, SMS, Twitter DM). 

This product can be expanded in the future by adding actionable notifications, like payment requests executable directly from a message.
how_its_made: Finally, we weren't able to host the app as a Safe app, largely because of the known internet problem - we couldn't tell if we're facing bugs or network issues. Also, we weren't able to deploy the dApp on StackOS, although we tried troubleshooting together with Vishnu, the founder, for around 3 hours. We decided to host the app only locally for the purpose of a demo.
